areas.name: Advertising
areas.detail: Ads LG places on the TV's screens.

areas.name: Tracking
areas.detail: What the TV learns about what is watched.

lgSettings.title: Screen saver ads
lgSettings.desc: Adverts that some apps, such as LG Channels, show in the screen saver. LG calls this Screen Saver Promotion.

lgSettings.title: Sponsored tiles on Home
lgSettings.desc: Adverts marked Sponsored on the Home screen. LG calls this Home Promotion.

lgSettings.title: Recommendations on Home
lgSettings.desc: Rows of recommended programmes and films on the Home screen. LG calls this Content Recommendation.

lgSettings.title: Ads while watching
lgSettings.desc: Adverts and offers shown over what is on screen, while LG's Live Plus is on. LG calls this Live Promotion.

lgSettings.title: Smart tips
lgSettings.desc: Suggestions for TV features that pop up while watching or using an app. LG calls this Smart Tips.

lgSettings.title: Smart tips in Settings
lgSettings.desc: Suggested settings shown in LG's Settings menu. LG calls this Smart Tips in Settings.

known.label: Viewing information
known.detail: Lets LG record what is watched.
